lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice producing a short organized argument with claim, reason, example, and conclusion.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Choosing how to organize a shared weekend activity with different preferences.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Building a compact argument and connecting it to a decision.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik decide whether a group should plan a quiet dinner or a larger outdoor activity this weekend.

main_focus.name: organized argument with för det första and sammanfattningsvis
main_focus.description: Structure a short spoken viewpoint with one reason, one example, and a conclusion.
model_examples: För det första passar en middag bättre när vädret är osäkert.
Sammanfattningsvis tycker jag att vi ska välja det enklare alternativet.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use structured argument markers naturally 3-4 times in the dialogue.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use social-planning words with clear argument-organization chunks.

dialogue_shape.opening: A social planning decision with two options is introduced.
dialogue_shape.middle: They each give a compact argument with a reason and example, then respond to one practical concern.
dialogue_shape.ending: They state a conclusion and agree how to communicate the plan.

target_complexity.repetition: argument markers should be visible but conversational

focus: the reason and example supporting the preferred option
the conclusion and how the plan will be communicated

sentence_focus: one sentence starting with för det första
one sentence giving an example with till exempel
one sentence adding a practical concern with samtidigt
one sentence summarizing the preferred plan
